subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: Should managed Memory Dreaming mark cron runs as error/partial-fail when any workspace sweep or promotion fails, or should cron remain ok while doctor/status surfaces the per-workspace Dreaming failure?
rationale: Current main fixed legacy state storage but still separates plugin-local Dreaming failures from cron run status, and the right user-facing semantics affect failure alerts, retry/backoff behavior, and operator diagnostics.

options.title: Surface Partial Failure In Cron
options.body: Treat any failed Dreaming workspace as a cron-visible degraded/error result or diagnostic so cron list/runs and failure alerts expose the problem.

options.title: Keep Cron Ok, Improve Doctor
options.body: Preserve current cron success semantics but make doctor/status and memory repair clearly report recent Dreaming failed/no-op sweeps.

options.title: Close After Live No-Repro
options.body: Close only if a current-release live repro confirms the remaining NO_REPLY/status-visibility symptom is gone and covered by existing diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Surface Partial Failure In Cron
recommendation.body: Treat any failed Dreaming workspace as a cron-visible degraded/error result or diagnostic so cron list/runs and failure alerts expose the problem.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent SQLite Dreaming-state migration that fixed the legacy subset and is the strongest current history signal for the remaining upgrade/status decision.
